responsibility: Declares the PHI-node manipulation API for GCC’s SSA form. It exposes PHI allocation/statistics helpers, block insertion/removal routines, argument management, degenerate-PHI querying, phi-node sequence installation, and inline utilities for accessing PHI argument immediate uses and recovering argument indices from use operands.
same_name_distinction: Declares the PHI-node manipulation interface and small inline utilities like gimple_phi_arg_imm_use_ptr and phi_arg_index_from_use. Unlike the .cc file, it does not implement PHI allocation pools, resizing, or block/argument mutation behavior.
